name: Mailercloud
description: Connect AI assistants to Mailercloud, the email marketing platform. Manage campaigns, contacts, lists, templates, automations, webhooks, and senders, plus transactional email — and get AI-powered campaign analysis, deliverability audits, engagement funnels, and best-practice recommendations. Ask in natural language to list and analyze campaigns, create and update contacts and lists, audit a draft before sending, and get an account health overview.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mailercloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mailercloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mailercloud.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mailercloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mailercloud lists 47 MCP tools, including analyze_campaign, analyze_latest_campaigns, audit_campaign_draft, batch_create_contacts, campaign_health_dashboard, compare_campaigns, create_campaign, create_contact, create_list, create_tag, create_template, and create_webhook.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mailercloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mailercloud in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Mailercloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mailercloud is developed by Mailercloud. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
